definition.def: Mental means relating to the process of thinking.
Mental means relating to the state or the health of a person's mind.
examples: The mental state that had created her psychosis was no longer present.

definition.def: A mental act is one that involves only thinking and not physical action.
examples: Practise mental arithmetic when you go out shopping.
Graham made a quick mental calculation.
She made a mental note not to sit anywhere near him.

definition.def: If you say that someone is mental, you mean that you think they are mad. [British, informal, disapproval]
If you make a mental note of something, you make an effort to store it in your memory so that you will not forget it.
examples: She made a mental note to have his prescription refilled.
